equities.name: TSX Composite
equities.commentary: The S&P/TSX Composite closed at 32,427 on March 31, rising 1.54% on the day — the advance followed reports of potential US-Iran diplomatic talks; the Strait of Hormuz closure had pushed the index approximately 6% lower over March.1 Year-over-year, the TSX is up 28.2%, with energy and materials sub-indices contributing to cumulative gains.1 The database tracks 63 oil and gas projects and 785 power and energy projects across Canada.3

equities.name: S&P 500
equities.commentary: The S&P 500 closed at approximately 6,497 on March 31, up 2.40% on the day — the index ended March approximately 9.4% below its January 2026 peak, with Hormuz-driven energy disruption dominating the month.2

equities.name: DJIA
equities.commentary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at approximately 46,117 on March 31, up approximately 2.0% on the day — industrial and energy-linked components led the session move on the Iran diplomatic reports.2

equities.name: Nasdaq Composite
equities.commentary: The Nasdaq Composite closed at approximately 21,469 on March 31, up 3.24% on the day — the largest single-session advance among the four major US indices in this edition.2
